assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Diagnosis code I34.0 is associated with the patient's condition.
Diagnosis code R00.2 is associated with the patient's condition.
The purpose of the test is to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities.
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197.
